ui_checks.observed: DEMO-002 was missing unit and approval was blocked. Unit 3 was saved as revision 2, then approval created revision 3.
Typing an unsaved instruction change immediately showed the draft note. The comparison stayed on saved revision 3 and download was disabled.
Saving changed instructions produced revision 4, broke the seal and preserved approved revision 3.
A real download attempt using the earlier export preview was blocked after the saved edit.
Reapproval created revision 5. Current approval 5 and older approval 3 each appeared once. Selecting the older approval retained native keyboard focus and did not mutate history or approval state.
A refreshed preview downloaded the inspected CSV for approved revision 5. Instructions, request ID, revision and approval timestamp matched the saved approval.
Creating REQ-57263399-ce4c-4008-8cda-47e7ebb25825 advanced DEMO-002 to revision 6, invalidated approval, identified the new unresolved counterpart and retained both records.

Resolving the relationship created revision 7; approval created revision 8. The selected older approval showed the condition absent. The current side showed the resolved condition and recorded reason truthfully, without a false pending-review claim.
ui_checks.recorded_reason: These are two separate cupboard doors in the same synthetic unit; keep both requests.

ui_checks.observed: With approval 3 selected and a dirty draft visible, another tab changed preferred time to Thursday, creating saved revision 9. The comparison refreshed to 9 while the draft base, draft text and focus were retained. Saving the stale draft was rejected.
Discarding the retained draft restored the latest saved values and removed the dirty-draft note.

The initial cross-tab run exposed stale approval-button, editor metadata and seal text. After the UI-only correction, approval created revision 10 and a dirty draft was started. Another tab changed preferred time to Friday, creating revision 11. The repeat showed draft base 10 / latest saved 11, Needs review, Save or discard draft, the broken revision-11 seal and retained approval-3 selection.
In a 360 CSS-pixel iframe the document did not overflow horizontally. Comparison sides stacked with explicit revision labels, and the long duplicate UUID wrapped.
